ref.locator: p. 155, Tabel II.5, blocks 'Arbeidsongevallen (aantal gerechtigden)' and 'Beroepsziekten (aantal vergoedingen)'
ref.note: Narrow line, so two phrases. For private-sector work accidents the employer's insurer pays most compensation, outside this line: Fedris says 'In principe betaalt de arbeidsongevallenverzekeraar van de werkgever deze vergoedingen. Enkel in specifieke situaties gebeurt de betaling door Fedris.' (Vergoedingen in de privésector (arbeidsongevallen) (https://www.fedris.be/nl/themas/vergoedingen-ao/vergoedingen-de-privesector)). The work-accident phrase therefore names Fedris: this line pays only what Fedris pays (the categories in Tabel II.5: lump-sum scheme, 'aanpassingsbijslag' supplements, the listed allowance categories; also medical costs for accidents before 1988, per Vergoedingen na arbeidsongeval (https://www.socialsecurity.be/citizen/nl/arbeidsongeschiktheid-ongeval-en-beroepsziekte/vergoedingen-na-arbeidsongeval)). Occupational-disease benefits are paid by Fedris itself. Amounts follow the law. corrected: work-accident phrase narrowed to what Fedris pays ('Fedris payments'), since private insurers pay most work-accident compensation (confirmed on fedris.be); occupational-disease phrase and quote confirmed
